newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul Exchange Takasbank to lend cash, shares.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul Exchange Takasbank to lend cash, shares.

text.p: Istanbul Stock Exchange Settlement and Custody Bank Takasbank A.S. will introduce new instruments to enable exchange members to borrow cash or shares from September 23, the bank said in a statement.

Takasbank will lend cash to the members to buy shares in the market. Members will also be able to borrow shares from a pool of shares lent by the Exchange's 165 members, including 104 brokerage houses.

Lending of shares will enable borrowers to close their short positions at settlement while lenders will benefit from commissions paid by the borrowers in addition to the returns earned on the shares they lend from their idle or medium-term stock positions, the bank said.
A stock exchange money market to be brokered by Takasbank is also to start operating on October 1.
The members will be able to utilise their surplus funds and meet their cash needs in the new market. Each member will be allotted certain cash and non-cash (share) limits.
The contracts made on the new money market will be under the guarantee of Takasbank. -- Istanbul newsroom +90-212-2750875
